brand_identity.tagline: Turning Ideas Into Intelligent Digital Solutions
brand_identity.logo_concept: Deep navy square container with clean white bold lowercase 'tif' lettering and distinct white wifi/signal radio arcs above the 'i', accompanied by a refined serif 'TECHNOLOGIES' wordmark below.
brand_identity.art_direction: Awwwards Site-of-the-Day level dark, premium tech aesthetic with deep navy (#0B0E1A, #121829, #1E1A5E) base, crisp icy blue highlights (#38BDF8, #60A5FA), glowing cyan accents (#06B6D4), and high-contrast ivory text (#F8FAFC). Combines kinetic typography, line-by-line reveal animations, smooth Lenis-style momentum scrolling, asymmetric bento layout grids, interactive service matrices, dynamic tech stack filters, and live project modal previews.
brand_identity.theme_mode: Dark tech primary with high-contrast light card accents and glowing glass panels

instructions_to_main_agent: Use JavaScript (.js/.jsx) for all components in /src.
Import Google Fonts ('Syne', 'Plus Jakarta Sans', 'JetBrains Mono') in index.css or index.html.
Implement Lenis smooth scroll and Framer Motion reveal effects on all main headings.
Ensure every interactive button, input, tab, card link, and nav item has explicit `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='nav-link-services'`, `data-testid='contact-form-submit'`).
Ensure header nav link is visible on desktop viewports and has solid/glass blurred background so text remains 100% legible over hero content.
Build the 10 services cards with deep descriptions, feature tags, and direct 'Request Consultation' modal/drawer action.
Include all portfolio items (News Arena, Khabar Gaon, News 4 Himachal, Home IVF, Dr Gauri Agarwal, Genestring Lab, Sansadflix, Future Shift Labs, Fundle Loyalty Program) with active category filters.
Add interactive form handling with success alert state and toast notifications using Sonner.
